frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The settled cessation/absence of an actively-held forward-looking expectation regarding a `min`-marked object or domain X: the subject no longer holds that something concerning X will come to pass, be attained, or recur. Domain- and affect-neutral at the root; realized dispositionally in the faʿūl nominal (yaʾūs), culminatively/terminally in Form X (istayʾasa), and as the plain act/state in Form I (yaʾisa) governing `min` X.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: The settled cessation/absence of an actively-held forward-looking expectation regarding a `min`-marked object or domain X: the subject no longer holds that something concerning X will come to pass, be attained, or recur. Domain- and affect-neutral at the root; realized dispositionally in the faʿūl nominal (yaʾūs), culminatively/terminally in Form X (istayʾasa), and as the plain act/state in Form I (yaʾisa) governing `min` X.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across the derivational family the root marks stopping-to-expect: someone ceases to count on X coming or returning. The thing expected is named by a `min` phrase — divine mercy/relief (29:23; 12:87), the Hereafter (60:13), the dead's return (60:13), one's religion's defeat (5:3), a missing person (12:80), or the recurrence of menstruation (65:4). The root itself supplies neither the emotion nor the desirability of X; those come from context. The faʿūl form (yaʾūs) names a person disposed to drop expectation of relief under adversity; Form X (istayʾasa) marks arriving at the terminal point of that loss. One occurrence, 13:31, breaks the `min` frame and takes an ʾan-clause and is carved out as a resistant seam.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: yAs does NOT entail (1) emotional anguish/grief — 65:4 (يَئِسْنَ مِنَ ٱلْمَحِيضِ, menopause) is a neutral legal descriptor of expectation-cessation with no distress, decisively refuting a 'despair-as-anguish' core; (2) that X is desired by the subject — in 5:3 disbelievers yaʾisa 'of your religion' (a hostile hope they wanted realized) and in 60:13 'of the grave-dwellers' (a return they deny); (3) factivity about the world — in 12:110 the messengers istayʾasū yet نَصْرُنَا came, so yAs is a subjective internal state reality can overturn; (4) mere ignorance/'not knowing' — it presupposes a held expectation now abandoned; (5) momentary disappointment — aspect is resultative/settled (note قَدْ يَئِسُوا۟ 60:13). It is a stance/state, not a deed, though it grounds conduct (فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ 5:3; the prohibition لَا تَا۟يْـَٔسُوا۟ 12:87). The Quran's own pairings (فَيَـُٔوسٌ قَنُوطٌ 41:49; لَيَـُٔوسٌ كَفُورٌ 11:9; and لَّا يَسْـَٔمُ set against فَيَـُٔوسٌ in 41:49) mark yAs as distinct from its neighbours q-n-ṭ, k-f-r, and s-ʾ-m rather than synonymous with them.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 13:31:20:1 — أَفَلَمْ يَا۟يْـَٔسِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَى ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا — is the only occurrence that abandons the `min` X frame and instead governs a propositional ʾan-clause; applying the expectation-cessation nucleus yields incoherence because the embedded proposition (had God willed He would have guided all) is affirmed as true by the verse itself and is thus not something to 'stop expecting', while the alternative cognitive sense 'come to know/realize' cannot be derived Quran-internally since 13:31 is a singleton with no supporting occurrence — so the bridge is undemonstrated and the node is carved out as RESISTANT rather than forced into the nucleus.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: Polysemy/homophony rather than a single family nucleus: yAs carries (1) 'drop expectation / despair of X' (12 occurrences on a uniform `min` frame) and (2) a distinct 'come to know/realize' sense at 13:31, whose unique ʾan-clause complement and the incoherence of 'cease-to-expect that P' suggest a second lexeme. This competitor is honest and locally undefeated at the 13:31 node on Quran-internal grounds, but it does not overturn the nucleus for the other 12 occurrences; because sense (2) rests on a single occurrence with no internal corroboration, positing it root-wide is unwarranted, so it is confined to the resistant seam.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Polysemy/homophony rather than a single family nucleus: yAs carries (1) 'drop expectation / despair of X' (12 occurrences on a uniform `min` frame) and (2) a distinct 'come to know/realize' sense at 13:31, whose unique ʾan-clause complement and the incoherence of 'cease-to-expect that P' suggest a second lexeme. This competitor is honest and locally undefeated at the 13:31 node on Quran-internal grounds, but it does not overturn the nucleus for the other 12 occurrences; because sense (2) rests on a single occurrence with no internal corroboration, positing it root-wide is unwarranted, so it is confined to the resistant seam.
internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge on one narrowest nucleus — settled cessation of an actively-held expectation regarding a `min`-marked X — and it survives its strongest stress tests: the emotion-free biological case 65:4 (refutes 'anguish' core), the hostile-object case 5:3 (refutes 'desired-object' requirement), and the reality-falsified case 12:110 (refutes factivity). The three derivational classes bridge cleanly and transparently: Form X (12:80) preserves the very `min` frame of Form I (12:80 مِنْهُ), so it is Form I intensified to its terminal point; the faʿūl nominal (yaʾūs) is the same nucleus lexicalized as a standing disposition, its affective colouring fully explained by object (relief under suffering) plus the intensive فَعُول pattern rather than loaded into the root. Distinctiveness from neighbours is drawn by the Quran itself (qanūṭ, kafūr, yasʾam co-listed as contrasts). The claim is scoped REPRESENTATIVE/DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY rather than UNIVERSAL because 13:31 presents a genuine syntactic anomaly (sole ʾan-clause) plus a contested cognitive reading with no internal warrant, which must be logged as a first-class resistant residue and prevents a universal-nucleus claim; falsification is therefore NOT_RUN with 13:31 in counterevidence.

reconciliation.rationale: Two of three lenses treat it as bridgeable-but-strained and one carves it out entirely; on the shared principle that an undemonstrated bridge must not be asserted, the honest disposition is RESISTANT — the 12/13 nucleus stands, the singleton is logged as a seam.

adversarial_verification.notes: A full adversarial refutation was not certified as PASSED because one occurrence (13:31) genuinely resists the nucleus via a unique ʾan-clause complement and a contested cognitive reading. occurrence_dispositions.note: Carved out of the family nucleus as a resistant seam; recorded in counterevidence_refs and hard_cases rather than smoothed into the nucleus. | 13:31:20:1 — أَفَلَمْ يَا۟يْـَٔسِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَى ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا — is the only occurrence that abandons the `min` X frame and instead governs a propositional ʾan-clause; applying the expectation-cessation nucleus yields incoherence because the embedded proposition (had God willed He would have guided all) is affirmed as true by the verse itself and is thus not something to 'stop expecting', while the alternative cognitive sense 'come to know/realize' cannot be derived Quran-internally since 13:31 is a singleton with no supporting occurrence — so the bridge is undemonstrated and the node is carved out as RESISTANT rather than forced into the nucleus.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form I verb that uniquely abandons the `min` frame and takes a propositional ʾan-clause; either a strained propositional extension of the nucleus ('cease to expect that P') or a distinct cognitive sense ('come to know/realize'), neither demonstrable from a single occurrence.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: 13:31 أَفَلَمْ يَا۟يْـَٔسِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَى ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا — subject polarity is also inverted (believers, yAs commended) versus 12:87 (kuffār, yAs prohibited).
occurrence_dispositions.preliminary_note: Unique ʾan-clause complement and inverted evaluative polarity relative to 12:87 raised the question of a second cognitive sense.
occurrence_dispositions.reconciliation_rationale: Two of three lenses treat it as bridgeable-but-strained and one carves it out entirely; on the shared principle that an undemonstrated bridge must not be asserted, the honest disposition is RESISTANT — the 12/13 nucleus stands, the singleton is logged as a seam.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: Unique ʾan-clause complement and inverted evaluative polarity relative to 12:87 raised the question of a second cognitive sense.
resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: Two of three lenses treat it as bridgeable-but-strained and one carves it out entirely; on the shared principle that an undemonstrated bridge must not be asserted, the honest disposition is RESISTANT — the 12/13 nucleus stands, the singleton is logged as a seam.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (two constructive, one adversarial) converged on the same nucleus and the same single resistant occurrence.
candidate_root_contribution: The settled cessation/absence of an actively-held forward-looking expectation regarding a `min`-marked object or domain X: the subject no longer holds that something concerning X will come to pass, be attained, or recur. Domain- and affect-neutral at the root; realized dispositionally in the faʿūl nominal (yaʾūs), culminatively/terminally in Form X (istayʾasa), and as the plain act/state in Form I (yaʾisa) governing `min` X.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 13 tokens: uniform `min` + nominal-domain frame across 7 Form I verbs and both Form X verbs (12:80 minhu), three faʿūl predicates of al-insān in adversity; sole deviation is 13:31's ʾan-clause.
layer_attribution.derivation: Form I yaʾisa (base act/state), Form X istayʾasa (terminative/culminative intensification retaining the `min` frame), فَعُول yaʾūs (intensive-dispositional nominalization) — a coherent single family, aspect/intensity modulated by morphology.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: faʿūl yaʾūs functions as a standing dispositional adjective; its affective colouring derives from the intensive pattern plus the desirability of the withdrawn good, not from the root.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: 'Despair' as felt anguish and the kufr-linked theological valence (12:87, 29:23, 5:3, 60:13) are contextual overlays attaching when X is a desired divine good; 65:4 (menopause) and 5:3 (hostile object) show these are not root-level.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: 13:31 preliminarily flagged STRUCTURAL_UNCERTAINTY was finalized RESISTANT because the cognitive-sense bridge is Quran-internally undemonstrated and the nucleus is incoherent there; the other 12 reconcile as one family nucleus.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: 13:31:20:1 persists as a resistant seam — unique propositional ʾan-complement, inverted evaluative polarity vs 12:87, and a contested 'come to know' reading with no corroborating occurrence — preventing a universal claim and holding the scope at REPRESENTATIVE/DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY.

hard_cases.reason: Only occurrence abandoning the `min` X frame for a propositional ʾan-clause; the nucleus is incoherent here and the alternative cognitive sense is Quran-internally underivable from a singleton.

evidence_basis.statement: 13:31:20:1 — أَفَلَمْ يَا۟يْـَٔسِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَى ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا — is the only occurrence that abandons the `min` X frame and instead governs a propositional ʾan-clause; applying the expectation-cessation nucleus yields incoherence because the embedded proposition (had God willed He would have guided all) is affirmed as true by the verse itself and is thus not something to 'stop expecting', while the alternative cognitive sense 'come to know/realize' cannot be derived Quran-internally since 13:31 is a singleton with no supporting occurrence — so the bridge is undemonstrated and the node is carved out as RESISTANT rather than forced into the nucleus.

hard_case_representation.rationale: A single genuine resistant occurrence (13:31) is documented from packet morphology and complementation; its evidence statement is persisted verbatim as strongest_counterexample and in the hard case's evidence_basis. The remaining 12 occurrences bridge cleanly across all three derivational classes.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A packet occurrence of yAs whose `min`-marked object is a genuinely undesired-and-expected-to-continue thing dropped WITH manifest grief-affect encoded by the verb itself, OR a second `min`-framed occurrence that can only mean 'come to know' — either of which would show 'settled cessation of expectation' is not the affect-neutral family nucleus but a lexicalized despair term or a homonym.
rejection_condition.search_location: The seven Form I `min`-frame tokens (29:23, 5:3, 60:13×2, 65:4, 12:87×2), the two Form X tokens (12:80, 12:110), and the three faʿūl N tokens (11:9, 17:83, 41:49); re-examine complement type and whether affect/desirability is verb-encoded vs context-supplied.
rejection_condition.verification_method: For each token check the `min`-object's desirability and whether removing contextual cues (co-listed kafūr/qanūṭ, adversity frame) leaves any grief-affect or knowledge sense attributable to the verb alone; compare 65:4 (neutral) against 29:23 (same construction) as the control pair.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Hold morphology constant: do not attribute the فَعُول pattern's intensive/dispositional colouring or the Form X terminative nuance to the root; separate object-desirability and narrative context from lexical content; treat orthographic variants (yaA@yo vs ya}is) as non-semantic.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If such a finding holds, the affect-neutral single-family nucleus is rejected: either downgrade to a LEXICALIZED_CLASS despair reading for the N/adversity tokens or split the root into unbridged senses, and re-scope away from DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY.

reopen_conditions: If a Quran-internal reading of 13:31:20:1 (أَفَلَمْ يَا۟يْـَٔسِ ... أَن) is established that either securely assimilates the ʾan-clause to the expectation-cessation nucleus or securely fixes a distinct 'come to know' sense — reopen to decide between DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY and a root split.
If the Form X tokens (12:80 istayʾasū minhu, 12:110 istayʾasa al-rusul) are shown to carry a sense NOT reducible to terminative intensification of the Form I `min`-frame verb, reopen the VX↔V bridge.

If the faʿūl N tokens (11:9, 17:83, 41:49) are shown to lexicalize a grief-affect that the verb tokens (esp. neutral 65:4) do not share, reopen whether N is a LEXICALIZED_CLASS separate from the base-verb nucleus.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: A full adversarial refutation was not certified as PASSED because one occurrence (13:31) genuinely resists the nucleus via a unique ʾan-clause complement and a contested cognitive reading. The core holds for 12/13 with strong distinctiveness from neighbours (q-n-ṭ, k-f-r, s-ʾ-m), so the resistant node is recorded in counterevidence_refs and as a RESISTANT_SEAM hard case rather than asserting PASSED or declaring the claim FAILED.
